membership.name: Membership

seo.title: Membership Management Software for Associations & Nonprofits | Donorfit
seo.description: Register members, configure membership plans, collect dues by SEPA or card and automate renewals — all in one membership workspace built for associations and nonprofits.

membership.headline: Simplify Membership Management for Your Organisation.
membership.subheadline: Register members, set up plans and categories, collect dues and run renewals from one organised workspace — so your team stops chasing fees.

intro.title: One place for every member, plan and payment
intro.body: Donorfit Membership replaces paper forms, invoice spreadsheets and reminder emails with a single member record. Members sign up online, choose their plan and authorise dues; your team sees who is active, who is due and who needs a reminder.

problems.problem: Annual dues are chased by hand with invoices and reminder emails.
problems.solution: Recurring SEPA Direct Debit or card billing collects dues automatically, with renewal reminders sent for you.

problems.problem: Member details live in several spreadsheets and quickly go out of date.
problems.solution: Members update their own contact details in a self-service portal, so every record stays current.

problems.problem: Student, family and organisational rates are hard to keep track of.
problems.solution: Configure as many membership tiers as you need, each with its own fee and renewal cycle.

features.title: Member registration
features.description: Online sign-up forms with custom application fields and the documents your organisation needs.

features.title: Plans and categories
features.description: Standard, student, senior, family, organisational or patron plans — annual, monthly or lifetime.

features.title: Member records
features.description: Contact details, plan, join date, status and payment history together on one profile.

features.title: Dues collection
features.description: SEPA Direct Debit mandates (B2C and B2B) and card billing, with automatic retries for failed payments.

features.title: Renewal workflows
features.description: Automatic renewal reminders, payment method updates and confirmation notices.

features.title: Directory and segments
features.description: Filter members by status, join date, voting eligibility or regional chapter.

benefits.description: Recurring billing and reminders replace manual invoices and follow-ups.

benefits.title: Reliable member lists
benefits.description: Up-to-date lists of active, dues-paid members for general assemblies and governance.

benefits.title: A better member experience
benefits.description: Instant receipts and a simple portal for members to manage their own details.

audiences.description: Professional bodies, clubs and cultural associations with annual dues.

audiences.title: Community organisations
audiences.description: Masjid committees, community centres and volunteer groups with regular members.

audiences.title: Charities with supporter membership
audiences.description: Organisations offering friends, patron or supporter schemes.

faqs.question: Can we collect membership fees by SEPA Direct Debit?
faqs.answer: Yes. Donorfit creates compliant SEPA Direct Debit mandates with pre-notifications and bank file exports, and also supports card billing.

faqs.question: Can corporate and individual members pay different rates?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure unlimited membership tiers with their own pricing, renewal cycles and application fields.

faqs.question: Can members update their own details?
faqs.answer: Yes. Members can update contact details, download membership contribution statements and manage their status through the self-service portal.

faqs.question: Can we see who is eligible to vote at our general assembly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Filter members by status and voting eligibility to produce a current list of active, dues-paid members.

cta.body: Set up your plans and open registration — your first renewals can run on autopilot.

intro.body: Donorfit Sponsorship keeps sponsors, beneficiaries and recurring contributions connected in one system. Your team always knows who sponsors whom, what has been paid and which update is due next — and sponsors see the difference they make.

problems.problem: Sponsor assignments, payments and updates are spread across spreadsheets.
problems.solution: Each sponsorship links a sponsor, a beneficiary or project, and their contributions in one record with a full history.

problems.problem: Failed or expired payments go unnoticed until a sponsor lapses.
problems.solution: SEPA Direct Debit and card payments with expiry reminders and automatic retries keep support uninterrupted.

problems.problem: Preparing progress reports for sponsors takes weeks of manual work.
problems.solution: Send education milestones, progress reports and thank-you updates through a secure sponsor portal.

faqs.question: Can we run one-to-one and pooled sponsorships?
faqs.answer: Yes. Donorfit supports one-to-one sponsorships, co-sponsorships with several sponsors per beneficiary, and community project sponsorships.

faqs.answer: Records are protected with granular, role-based permissions so field workers and administrators only access what they need, and unauthorised export is prevented.
